caseNameFull: Louis Clayton BARTON v. UNITED STATES.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the First Circuit. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the First Circuit for further consideration in light of Alleyne v. United States, --- U.S. ----, 133 S.Ct. 2151, --- L.Ed. ---- (2013).
